hero.title: Our Activities
hero.subtitle: Delivering practical solutions that support infrastructure development, economic growth, and community well-being across South Sudan.

intro.title: What We Do
intro.text: Five Investment Limited undertakes a wide range of activities that contribute to national development. From construction and procurement to agriculture and logistics, our experienced team works with government institutions, NGOs, private companies, and communities to deliver reliable and sustainable solutions.

coreActivities.title: Core Business Activities
coreActivities.description: Our key operational areas, carried out daily across South Sudan.

items.title: Construction Activities
items.text: Road construction, bridge construction, residential & commercial buildings, site preparation, renovation works, and civil engineering.

items.title: Procurement & Supply
items.text: NGO & government procurement, food & non‑food distribution, office furniture & stationery, printing, and hygiene materials.

items.title: Agricultural Activities
items.text: Commercial farming, food security initiatives, agricultural input distribution, seed supply, and farm equipment support.

items.title: Logistics & Transport
items.text: Transportation services, equipment transportation, material delivery, fleet management, and machinery hire.

items.title: Import & Export
items.text: Importation of equipment, construction materials, agricultural machinery, export support, and international trade coordination.

items.title: Industrial Activities
items.text: Light agro‑industries, food processing, agricultural product packaging, and small‑scale manufacturing.
